note: v3461: The cross-family eye reviewed the v3459 diff BEFORE it shipped and found two half-joined ends. First: the ratio was max over min across EVERY look, so one small look set the state for the whole version. Measured on v3401 - three looks, two of them at an IDENTICAL 33447 chars with DIFFERENT verdicts, which is the sharpest finding this function makes - and the 8885-char third look dragged max over min to 3.8x, so v3459 called it INCOMPARABLE and the real disagreement vanished. The question is per PAIR, not per version. Second: agreement_census counted DISAGREE and ECHO only, so seven versions were counted by nothing and a reader watching disagreements fall from 19 to 12 would read it as the instrument settling down.
